mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% (FEDFUNDS <= 3.0) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 3.0% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly elevated retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer and construction sector activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST above 12mo_ma) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production exceeding 120.0 (INDPRO > 120.0) signals overcapacity and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 120.0 during late-cycle expansion over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment exceeding 130,000 (thousands) (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates a robust labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 11000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2000 indicate strong aggregate demand that fuels corporate profitability and equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1>11000 and HOUST>2000) fails to yield positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), a federal funds rate above 4.0% (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) signals aggressive monetary tightening that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0 over any 5-year rolling window.
